sections.en: The Eastern and Western Appearance of Jupiter

summary.headline: Jupiter’s Eastern and Western Appearances
summary.text: Kindi’s astrological judgments on the eastern and western appearances of Jupiter, followed by sign-specific forecasts for Aries, Taurus, Gemini, and Cancer. The interpretations address rain and moisture, royal health and travel, disease, deaths among rulers’ families, state corruption, tyranny, and disturbances among subjects, with additional timing rules from Hermes and Ahmad Abd al-Jalil Sanjari.
